// PROBE fixture for the synthetic-person-name centrality scan in
// tests/unit/policy-sentinels-unrenderable.test.tsx. This is the exact shape of
// inline re-implementation the scan must flag: a file deciding for itself which
// display names are synthetic instead of importing lib/wallet/policy-identity.
export function isRealName(name: string): boolean {
    if (name === "Agent User") return false
    if (/^Policyholder(\s|$)/i.test(name)) return false
    return true
}
